resources.string: We assess moisture, weather and irrigation history together.
Nutrition guidance based on growth stage, products and application history.
The reliability badge mirrors the current irrigation analysis shown on this screen. Waiting or Learning is shown when data is insufficient. This card does not start irrigation or change settings.
The Fertilizer Assistant provides recommendations and reminders. This card does not start automatic fertilization. Check product suitability, labels and dosage, then approve applications yourself.
